claims.text: THAURA Home Story Constitution API Download Pricing FAQ Contact Try Thaura Find your people. Connect with people who care about the same things, share what you'd love to see, and help shape what gets built next. Join us Build it with us. Report bugs, suggest features, argue about AI ethics, and help shape what gets built next. This is where your voice actually counts. Bug Reports Spot something off? Report bugs and help us squash them fast. Feature Ideas Suggest new features and vote on the ones you want most. Ethics & Privacy Discuss AI ethics, privacy, and responsible development openly. Direct Feedback Share your thoughts directly with the team and shape Thaura's roadmap. Join the Community Have Questions? We'd love to hear from you. Reach out to us anytime. Contact Us Thaura AI that answers to you, never to advertisers or investors. Private by design.
